allow: PowerShell(Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Drawing; $files = @\('Assets/images/building/disaster_observatory.png', 'Assets/images/building/workplace3.png', 'Assets/resources/Farm.png'\); foreach \($f in $files\) { if \(Test-Path $f\) { $img = [System.Drawing.Image]::FromFile\(\(Resolve-Path $f\).Path\); Write-Output "$f : $\($img.Width\) x $\($img.Height\)"; $img.Dispose\(\) } else { Write-Output "NOT FOUND: $f" } })
